title: IUPAC Nomenclature of Organic Compounds
notes: **Root word:** indicates the number of carbon atoms in the longest chain. Meth- (1), Eth- (2), Prop- (3), But- (4), Pent- (5), Hex- (6).
**Suffix:** indicates the functional group. -ane (alkane), -ene (alkene), -yne (alkyne), -ol (alcohol), -al (aldehyde), -one (ketone), -oic acid (carboxylic acid), -amine.
**Prefix:** indicates substituents. Methyl- ($CH_3$), ethyl- ($C_2H_5$), chloro-, bromo-, iodo-, fluoro-, nitro-, amino-.
**Numbering:** choose the longest chain containing the principal functional group. Number from the end nearest to the functional group or substituent to give lowest locants.
**Multiple bonds:** double bond gets lower number than triple bond if both are present. Alphabetical order for multiple substituents.
